claims: Brad Underwood is the head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois.
Brad Underwood has held the position of head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois since 2017.
Brad Underwood has led the University of Illinois men's basketball team to multiple NCAA Tournament appearances.
Shauna Green is the head coach for the Illinois Fighting Illini women's basketball team.
Brad Underwood's tenure as head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois is 2017–present.
The 2025-26 season is Brad Underwood's 8th season as head men's basketball coach at the University of Illinois.
Brad Underwood led the University of Illinois men's basketball team to the 2021 Big Ten Tournament title.
Brad Underwood led the University of Illinois men's basketball team to a 2026 Sweet 16 appearance.
Brad Underwood's 2025-26 staff includes Associate Head Coach Orlando Antigua and Assistants Geoff Alexander, Tyler Underwood, Camryn Crocker, and Zach Hamer.
